source.name: UniProtKB
source.description: Reference proteome of Homo sapiens as distributed by UniProt; the assembly accession is the one UniProt states for this proteome.

documentation: Example metadata for a download of the UniProt human reference proteome. The protein and gene counts and the BUSCO report are UniProt's published values for UP000005640 (https://rest.uniprot.org/proteomes/UP000005640.json, fetched 2026-10-10); they are not recomputed. The checksum is a placeholder: this example has no sequence file.
